changes: Three new Casino Pot fines, on top of the existing losing-leg (250K) and wrong-tip (150K) fines: MIA Group Multi leg (50K), a Group Multi leg placed under $1.22 (10K), and a missed AFL tip (50K) — a known tipper with zero pick at all for a finished game.
All three tracked per-person, fully symmetric with the Ledger's Undo Week for the two group-multi ones.
Profile Fines tab now shows all five categories plus a combined total; the info panel lists all five amounts clearly.
Missed-tip detection needed a genuinely new mechanism to tell "never tipped" apart from "tipped correctly" — built on a roster of known tippers rather than guessing.
